evaluation.accuracy_note: Accuracy is excluded: at this base rate, always answering "no anomaly" scores 88.5% and predicts nothing.

explainability.note: SHAP values are in log-odds. The base value is -2.9478, which is 0.0498 as a probability.

cities_not_held_out.auckland: no labelled rows past the feature warm-up
cities_not_held_out.buenos_aires: no labelled rows past the feature warm-up
cities_not_held_out.johannesburg: no labelled rows past the feature warm-up
cities_not_held_out.sydney: no rows in the test split; its record ends 2021-09-07

leave_one_city_out.trained_on: every other city's train and validation splits

verdict.statement: Held out of training entirely, each of the 11 scored cities is still ranked better by the model than by its own persistence baseline (11 of 11, median PR-AUC 1.61x persistence and 98% of the same city's in-sample score), so the model transfers to a city it has never seen.

leave_one_city_out.yardstick: that city's own persistence baseline, not its base rate

calibration.recommendation_note: Isotonic on validation halves the calibration error and is worth shipping. The prior shift is not: its EM estimate of the target prior is badly biased here, and no choice among the candidate quantifiers can be made on validation. See quantifier_diagnostics.

calibrated.what: isotonic fitted on validation, applied to test

calibrated_prior_shifted.what: and re-weighted to the prior EM estimates on the target period

prior_shifted_oracle.what: NOT SHIPPABLE: re-weighted to the observed test prior, to show what the correction is worth when the estimate is right

threshold_sensitivity.statement: Re-run at |Z| thresholds 2, 2.5, 3, the recommended model beats every baseline on PR-AUC, Brier and F1 at all three.
